# Draft Release Notes: TreeGrid & Data Pipeline Architecture

Sub-task of Epic #9569.

This ticket tracks the drafting of the **TreeGrid & Data Pipeline Architecture** section for the v12.1 release notes.

**Scope:**
- `Neo.data.TreeStore` and `TreeModel` implementation.
- "Turbo Mode" and Async Subtree Loading for hierarchical data.
- The new Data Pipeline architecture (`Connection -> Parser -> Normalizer`).
- The TreeGrid Big Data Demo (organic data generation algorithm).
